Address offset: 0x000
Reset value: 0x00000002
[Table 366. DCMIPP registers organization]
Bits 31:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 24 QOS_MODE: Quality of service
Set of functions enabling to build and configure an architecture meeting bandwidth and latency
requirements.
Bits 23:3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:0 MEMORYPAGE[2:0]: Memory page size, as power of 2 of 64-byte units:
0x0: 64 bytes
0x1: 128 bytes
0x2: 256 bytes
0x3: 512 bytes
0x4: 1K bytes
0x5: 2K bytes
0x6: 4K bytes
0x7: 8K bytes
